items.name: Hotel Ginebra
items.description:
You might be eligible for a Genius discount at Hotel Ginebra. To check if a Genius discount is available for your selected dates sign in.


Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

Offering free WiFi and air conditioning, Hotel Ginebra is located in the heart of Barcelona, just off Plaza Catalunya. La Rambla and the luxury shops of Paseo de Gracia are 250 metres from the hotel.

Modern rooms at Hotel Ginebra feature a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, coffee and tea making facilities, a free safety deposit box and a private bathroom with shower including a hairdryer and free toiletries.

Facilities include a shared TV lounge, luggage storage and laundry service. A wide range of restaurants can be found in Plaza Catalunya, just across the street.

The main train and metro station in Barcelona is 100 metres from the hotel, and the airport shuttle bus provides a direct link from Plaza Catalunya to El Prat Airport. There is government parking available next to the hotel.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.7 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

items.description:
You might be eligible for a Genius discount at Passeig De Gràcia Luxury. To check if a Genius discount is available for your selected dates sign in.


Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

Set 50 metres from Plaza Catalunya, Passeig De Gràcia Luxury is a stylish apartment featuring views over the elegant Passeig de Gracia Boulevard. It offers air conditioning and free Wi-Fi.

This modern apartment has a flat-screen TV, iPod dock, dining table and a sofa bed in the living room. A dishwasher, washing machine and an oven are included in the well-equipped kitchen area. There is a double bedroom, a twin bedroom and a bathroom with a shower.

You can find a wide variety of restaurants and bars within a 5-minute walk of the apartment. El Corte Inglés department store is 100 metres away and there are many designer shops on Passeig de Gracia.

Gaudi’s famous La Pedrera and Casa Batllo are less than 15 minutes’ walk from Passeig De Gràcia Luxury. Las Ramblas is 400 metres away. Catalunya Metro Station is 50 metres from the apartment and Park Guell is a 10-minute metro ride away.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 10 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

items.name: Hotel Àmbit Barcelona
items.description:
Located 400 metres from Barcelona’s Plaça Catalunya, Hotel Àmbit Barcelona offers modern, air-conditioned rooms with free WiFi. Urquinaona Metro Station is a 3-minute walk away.

Every room is fitted with a flat-screen TV, minibar and private bathroom with a hairdryer and free toiletries. Some rooms have a terrace or balcony.

You will find a 24-hour front desk at the property, where staff can help with bike hire, car hire and tourist information. Free coffee is available 24 hours on the first floor.

The shopping street, Portal de l'Angel, is 500 metres from Hotel Àmbit Barcelona, while Barcelona Cathedral is 800 metres away. There are many restaurants in the area.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.6 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

Ola Living Plaza Catalunya is located in central Barcelona, next to Plaza Catalunya. It offers modern, air-conditioned apartments with free WiFi.

The apartments feature stylish décor and parquet floors. Each one has a lounge with a flat-screen TV. The kitchen comes with a hob, oven and microwave, as well as a dishwasher. Bed linen and towels are provided.

The apartments are next to Passeig de Gràcia Boulevard, where you can find many high-end shops as well as Gaudí's Casa Batlló and La Pedrera. Within 200 metres you can walk to the city's Gothic Quarter.

The nearest Metro Stops are Passeig de Gràcia and Catalunya, both within 250 metres. Airport buses leave from Plaza Catalunya.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 8.3 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

hostInfo.name: Ola Living
hostInfo.welcomeMessage: Apartments in the heart of the city, next to Plaza Cataluña and Paseo de Gracia, two of the most important attractions and the best areas of interest. The Gothic Quarter and the Born are just 5 minutes away. It has Wi-fi Internet connection, air conditioning and safe. The bright living room has a comfortable sofa, which converts into a bed, with flat-screen TV, tables and chairs. There is also a fully equipped kitchen. There are two bedrooms with double beds. The bathroom is finished in white marble and has a shower. The flat is provided with towels and bed linen on arrival. This flat does not have private parking. However, there is a public car park within 250 metres of the flat. The photographs shown of this flat are a selection of various flats in the same building. The flats may vary in terms of decoration and layout, but they all have the same style.
hostInfo.ownerInfo:
Ola Living is an innovative and modern company dedicated to the rental of tourist flats, the temporary rental of city flats and the rental of rooms for stays of more than 32 days.
The founding partners and management have more than 17 years of experience in the sector and have applied all their knowledge to create a modern, technologically advanced company where the customer is at the centre of our thinking and our aim is to make your experience unforgettable.
Our buildings have been carefully selected and decorated to the highest standards to make our clients feel at home.
Our team is totally at the disposal of our clients so that during their stay they have the necessary support to feel like in a hotel but with the privacy, spaciousness and comfort of a flat.
hostInfo.neighboorhoodInfo: From the flat, a short 5-minute walk takes you to the heart of the Gothic Quarter and the Born, one of Barcelona's oldest and most popular neighbourhoods. It is an intricate maze of squares, all interconnected by narrow medieval streets. Here you'll find countless trendy boutiques, great bars, charming cafés and delicious restaurants. Near Lumino, you can stroll along the legendary Ramblas and visit the many landmarks the city has to offer, such as the Liceu Opera House, the cathedral and the Born quarter of the Barri Gòtic, the Parc de la Ciutadella, the Arc de Triomf and the Rambla de Catalunya. Plaça de Catalunya is the largest square in the centre, and at 30,000 square metres is the third largest square in Spain. Some of Barcelona's most important streets and avenues intersect with this beloved square, famous for its fountain and statues.

items.name: Boutique Hotel H10 Catalunya Plaza
items.description:
The striking Boutique Hotel H10 Catalunya Plaza is set directly on the square, just 200 metres from Las Ramblas. It offers chic, air-conditioned rooms with free Wi-Fi and a lovely chill-out terrace.

The stylish rooms at Boutique Hotel H10 Catalunya Plaza have lightly coloured contemporary décor. All feature a coffee maker with 2 free capsules, a safe, minibar and 1 bottle of water per person on arrival. A luxury apartment is also available.

Modern bathrooms include H10 toiletries, a hairdryer, magnifying mirror, a bathrobe and slippers. Some rooms also have views of the square or feature a terrace.

Dating from the 19th century, the hotel combines original ornate tiles, murals and carved wooden doors with modern finishes.

The 1892 Restaurant offers traditional Catalan dishes, a Modernist ceiling and great views of the square. There is also a lobby-bar and a library.

The H10 has a 24-hour reception, where staff can provide you with information on Barcelona. There is also a 24-hour internet terminal.

Boutique Hotel H10 Catalunya Plaza is just 20 metres from Catalunya Metro and train stations. The Aerobus shuttle to Barcelona Airport leaves from the other side of Plaza Catalunya.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.6 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

items.name: You Stylish City Center Apartments
items.description:
You might be eligible for a Genius discount at You Stylish City Center Apartments. To check if a Genius discount is available for your selected dates sign in.


Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

Located next to Plaza Catalunya Station, You Stylish City Center Apartments offers modern apartments with air conditioning and free WiFi. These luxury apartments are, and just a 1-minute walk from Las Ramblas.

Each apartment is spacious and bright, with heating and elegant contemporary décor. The modern kitchens include a ceramic hob, dishwasher and kitchenware.

Guests have access to a 24-hour concierge service.

There are numerous restaurants and shops within a 2-minute walk, including El Corte Inglés supermarket. The You Stylish tour desk provides visitor information, and there is a Tourist Office just 150 metres away. There is a swimming pool and gym nearby available for guests at an extra cost.

Direct buses to Barcelona Airport stop only 50 metres from the apartments. Plaza Catalunya Station offers direct Metro links to all areas of Barcelona, as well as trains to the Pyrenees and the Costa Brava.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.5 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

items.name: Catalonia Plaza Catalunya
items.description:
You might be eligible for a Genius discount at Catalonia Plaza Catalunya. To check if a Genius discount is available for your selected dates sign in.


Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

Hotel Catalonia Plaza Cataluña offers an outdoor pool and air-conditioned rooms with free Wi-Fi and satellite TV. It is housed in a building 50 metres from Barcelona’s Plaza Catalunya. All hotel rooms have smart TVs equipped with Chromecast app.

The hotel serves a continental buffet breakfast with show cooking and it includes a wide variety of regional products and home-made cakes.

Catalonia Plaza Cataluña Hotel has a sun terrace with loungers, a gym and a pool. Guests can also enjoy the on-site spa and cabin for spa treatments and massages.

Hotel Catalonia Plaza is a 5-minute walk from Barcelona’s Gothic Quarter and the Palau de la Música Catalana. A regular bus service to the airport leaves from the other side of Plaza Catalunya, just 100 metres away.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.7 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

items.description:
You might be eligible for a Genius discount at Izaila Plaza Catalunya. To check if a Genius discount is available for your selected dates sign in.


Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

Izaila Plaza Catalunya features free WiFi, air conditioning and heating. Located in the centre of Barcelona, this hotel is 50 metres from Plaza Catalunya Square.

The bright rooms at Izaila Plaza Catalunya include a flat-screen TV and a wardrobe. The private bathroom comes with a shower, free toiletries and a hairdryer. Some rooms have a balcony with city views.

Guests have access to a shared lounge and a library. The hotel offers tourist information and free storage luggage.

The hotel is a 2 minute walk from Plaza Catalunya metro and train stations. The famous Sagrada Familia Cathedral is 2.5 km away. Passeig de Gracia, with its high end shops and Gaudi's La Pedrera and Casa Batlló, is within 5 minutes' walk from Izaila Plaza Catalunya.

Barcelona Airport is 20 minutes away by car. Buses run regularly between the airport and Plaza Catalunya Square.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.9 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

To see correct prices and occupancy information, please add the number of children in your group and their ages to your search. Cot and extra bed policies 0 - 2 years Extra bed upon request Cot upon request 3+ years Extra bed upon request Prices for cots are not included in the total price, and will have to be paid for separately during your stay. The number of cots allowed is dependent on the option you choose. Please check your selected option for more information. There are no extra beds available at this property. All cots are subject to availability.
